caption: The drawing depicts a single long overcoat viewed from the back, centered vertically and horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The overcoat is rendered in shades of purple and brown, with subtle variations indicating the texture and folds of the fabric. It has a high collar, long sleeves with visible cuffs that are buttoned, and loose front panels that form slight vertical pleats extending down from the shoulders to the hem. There are no visible fastenings on the coat’s back, and the coat’s length comes down to just below the knee. The drawing is detailed in the depiction of shadows and highlights to suggest the volume and drape of the garment, while the rest of the space is empty and unadorned.
title: Man's Coat
